# MediaPipe Tasks Vision runtime

Vendored package: `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.22-rc.20250304`

Face Landmarker model: MediaPipe `face_landmarker/float16/latest`.

These files are used only for on-device face landmark detection and makeup-region mask generation. They do not generate the final try-on image.
